name: Agent Skills
description: Agent Skills from a GitHub repo, installed user-level (~/.claude/skills) for the container user with the skills CLI.

ref.description: A commit, branch or tag to install from. Empty means the default branch; a commit SHA makes builds reproducible.

skills.description: Space-separated skill names to install, or * for all of them.

agent.description: The agent to install for (the skills CLI's --agent).

cliVersion.description: The skills CLI (npm package skills) version to run.
